name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
steps: Sit tall on the floor with both legs extended straight together in front of you and your toes pointing upward.
Hinge slowly forward from your hips, reaching your hands along your shins toward your ankles or feet while keeping your spine long.
Stop when you feel a smooth, comfortable stretch along the backs of both thighs.
Hold the stretched position while breathing steadily, then sit back upright gently to release.
tips: Lead with your chest toward your thighs rather than forcefully rounding your upper back to touch your toes.
Keep a tiny unlock in your knees if locking them completely feels uncomfortable behind the joints.
